headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time risk assessment tools to provide users with up-to-date security and dependency information, ensuring that the latest threats are mitigated before installation. Incorporate user feedback mechanisms to continuously improve the app’s accuracy and relevance. Leverage AI-driven insights to predict potential issues based on historical data and current trends.
actions: Integrate real-time threat databases to check for known vulnerabilities in dependencies during the install process.
Implement a user feedback system where users can report suspicious packages or issues, which will be used to update the app's risk assessment models.
Use AI algorithms to analyze public repositories and trends to predict potential risks associated with new package versions before they are installed.
